equation_summary: LightNet is a GLA channel-decay mixer with value-first state layout and a normalized-key frontend. The keys are normalized via a log-cumsum-exp over time: z_t = logcumsumexp(k), k_t' = exp(k_t - z_t), g_t = z_{t-1} - z_t; this (k', g) pair feeds chunk_gla / fused_recurrent_gla with state_v_first=True. The state law is the GLA channel-diagonal decay h_t = diag(exp(g_t)) h_{t-1} + k_t'^T v_t, o_t = q_t h_t (after-update read). The log-cumsum-exp state z is carried as an additional ffn_state for decode continuation.
state_shape: [B,H,K,V] matrix (value-first layout); plus a [B,H,K] log-cumsum-exp (z) continuation state
gate_scope: channel (per-key-channel diagonal gate g, derived externally from key log-cumsum-exp)
normalization: key normalization via external log-cumsum-exp (k normalized by running log-sum-exp)
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM E[projections/short conv/key normalization/gates]: q/k/v projections, optional short convs, and the log-cumsum-exp key normalization + gate construction are all external frontend
CONFIRM U2.A(channel decay): the mixer call is literally chunk_gla/fused_recurrent_gla with channel-diagonal g
CONFIRM E[gated output]: rms_norm_swish_gate_linear with a low-rank g_proj is the external output gate
CONFIRM blockers: all frontend states (recurrent + ffn_state z + conv states) and B[channel-decay native envelope]
direction_justification: LightNet's mixer is exactly the GLA channel-decay U2.A; the key normalization and gate derivation are external frontend, so it composes once the channel-decay envelope and K2 binder exist.
open_questions: The decode path continues the log-cumsum-exp from a cached z (ffn_state); the state bundle must include both the GLA recurrent state and the z scalar state for continuation.
evidence_citations: fla/layers/lightnet.py:176-193 — z = logcumsumexp(k); k = exp(k - z); g = z_prev - z (with nan_to_num): external key normalization and channel-gate derivation
fla/layers/lightnet.py:196-217 — fused_recurrent_gla / chunk_gla called with gk=g, state_v_first=True: the mixer is GLA channel-decay U2.A
